UsageNow

Privacy Policy

UsageNow is local-first, but it uses direct provider connections and optional Apple private sync. This policy lists each route instead of relying on a blanket privacy label.

Last updated: 2026-09-13

Data flow and control

  • Provider credentials

    Credentials are stored only in the main app's local Keychain using AfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly. They are not synchronizable, are not exposed to extensions, and never enter UserDefaults, CloudKit, App Group, Widget, Apple Watch, exports, screenshots, analytics, or source control. Removing a connection or deleting all data erases the corresponding Keychain item.

  • Direct provider API requests

    When you ask to connect or refresh, your device sends the credential and minimum required request fields directly to the selected provider's documented official API over HTTPS. That provider receives and processes the request under its own terms. UsageNow does not route provider traffic through a developer server, proxy, tunnel, or VPN.

  • What the developer receives

    The UsageNow developer does not automatically receive your token, provider account data, usage values, request, provider response, normalized snapshots, or CloudKit records. UsageNow has no developer-operated account system or usage database.

  • Local records and exports

    Normalized usage snapshots, reset times, forecasts, freshness, account labels, preferences, and trial state are stored locally. An export is created only when you request it and goes to a destination you choose through Apple's system interface. Exports exclude credentials and raw provider responses; the destination's privacy terms then apply.

  • Optional private CloudKit

    Only when you enable iCloud sync, minimized provider identifiers, anonymous account labels, normalized usage values, reset and forecast data, freshness, preferences, and the minimum trial anchor may be stored in your Apple private CloudKit database. Credentials and raw provider payloads are never included. Apple operates CloudKit; UsageNow does not create a separate developer database.

  • App Group, Widget, and Apple Watch

    App Group storage gives Widget only a secret-free capacity snapshot. WatchConnectivity sends a secret-free snapshot to the paired Apple Watch for UsageNow views and complications. These payloads may contain normalized capacity, reset, freshness, and display preferences, but never credentials, cookies, request headers, or raw provider responses.

  • StoreKit and purchases

    StoreKit contacts Apple to load the product and localized price and to verify, purchase, or Restore the non-consumable lifetime unlock. Apple processes the transaction. UsageNow reads verified entitlement information and does not receive payment card details.

  • Security-safe diagnostics

    Local diagnostics may record a broad event type, status code, time, and non-secret correlation identifier. They are not automatically uploaded and never include a token, password, cookie, organization or workspace slug, full URL, request body, response body, or header. Do not send those secrets in a support message.

  • No advertising, analytics, tracking, or scraping

    UsageNow has no advertising SDK, third-party analytics, cross-app tracking, device fingerprint, or developer marketing profile. It does not collect passwords, import browser cookies, scrape dashboard HTML, call private endpoints, impersonate official clients, reuse official client tokens, or bypass rate limits.

  • Deletion and the retained generation

    Delete all data removes the local repository, Keychain, App Group, Widget cache, Apple Watch payload, private CloudKit records, and trial anchor. UsageNow retains only a non-identifying CloudKit deletion generation so an offline device cannot resurrect deleted content. It contains no provider, usage, account, credential, device fingerprint, or trial data. Files you exported and Apple-managed device backups remain under your control and must be removed separately.

  • Support email and this website

    If you email support, the developer receives the email address and message you choose to send and uses them only to answer you. This static website sets no cookies and loads no advertising, analytics, tracking scripts, or third-party assets. The eventual hosting service may process standard connection information under its own privacy terms.

  • Provider independence

    These names are used only to identify compatible services: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google/Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, xAI/Grok, OpenRouter. UsageNow is independent and is not endorsed, sponsored, or affiliated with those providers.

Contact UsageNow support

Include your device model, operating system and app version, provider compatibility name, connection method, status code, and approximate time. Never send an access token, password, cookie, organization or workspace slug, full URL, request or response body, or headers.
